qualification: Not qualified. mini-x64 is uefi-x64's platform on a disk declared for 128 MB of flash (mica:docs/plan/20260926-0930-mini-images-on-128-mb.md), with its own kernel configuration. It shares the signed-verity root and the file deployments, and no run has qualified it yet: the evidence below is the mechanism it relies on, not a result measured on this board. Development signing inputs only; not a release target.

evidenceRefs.ref: mica-build:src/verify, run as mica-build:src/cli.ts verify --board mini-x64, pending the plan's P3 run

physicalBoundaries.jtag: Generic PC platform; Mica OS specifies no JTAG/SWD port and controls none -- debug exposure is defined by the platform owner's hardware and firmware.
physicalBoundaries.serialConsole: Present where the platform exposes one, with a login prompt only; no account accepts a credential (docs/design/access.md section 2).
physicalBoundaries.recoveryPath: Whole-disk reflash from external boot media through the machine's own UEFI firmware; open to physical access by design (docs/design/security-model.md section 1).
